scientific_integrity: Full infinite-family derivation given analytically; exact rational checks are supplementary, not a proof by sampling. Earlier source constructions are attributed. No independent external validation is claimed.
scientific_limitations: Exact multiplicity law pertains to the nonoptimized integer-lattice covering by K_m for integer m>=2, almost everywhere, not all minimal coverings or optimal covering lattices. Previously published explicit fiber endpoints and minimality are used as inputs; prior literature could implicitly or explicitly contain the consequences.
title: Cubic overlap spectrum of minimal Reeve-prism lattice coverings
